tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background behind every module. Carries ink and muted text, and the sticky top bar.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Raised objects: boxes, demo consoles, quiz cards, tables, popovers. Ink and muted text read on it.

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Second level: table headers, tinted boxes, lessons, metric tiles, hover fill on rail links.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and headings on bg, surface and surface-2. Also the 2px rule above tips and takeaways.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: ledes, captions, eyebrows, metadata, idle rail links. Reads on bg, surface and surface-2.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines, card and input borders, table rules, idle control borders. Decorative only: 1.3 to 1.4:1 on bg and surface in both themes, as in the source, so hover and focus turn a control border accent and nothing relies on line alone.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The one brand hue: links, primary buttons, the active rail stage, focus rings, quiz borders, module numbers. As text on bg, surface and accent-soft.

tokens.name: accent-ink
tokens.usage: Text on an accent fill: the primary button, the active stage pill, the home-page CTA.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind accent text: callouts, highlighted code lines, the human-step pill, search highlights.

tokens.name: code-bg
tokens.usage: Code blocks, the event log, tool-call snippets and trace detail panes. Ink and muted text read on it.

tokens.name: think
tokens.usage: Loop phase 1, the model reasoning (plan). Phase pill, timeline step, diagram node, log event. Text on bg, surface and think-soft.

tokens.name: think-soft
tokens.usage: Fill behind think text, and the background of a whole think step in the timeline.

tokens.name: act
tokens.usage: Loop phase 2, a tool call (act). Also the simulation banner label. Text on bg, surface and act-soft.

tokens.name: act-soft
tokens.usage: Fill behind act text; the full-width simulation banner.

tokens.name: observe
tokens.usage: Loop phase 3, a tool result (observe). Text on bg, surface and observe-soft; the left rule on extracted quotes.

tokens.name: observe-soft
tokens.usage: Fill behind observe text.

tokens.name: final
tokens.usage: Loop phase 4, the final answer (finish). Also a correct quiz answer and the 'yes' cell in comparison tables.

tokens.name: final-soft
tokens.usage: Fill behind final text; a correct quiz option. In light, final on final-soft is 4.3:1, just under 4.5:1 for small text; kept exact from the source, so keep pill text at weight 500 or bolder.

tokens.name: bad
tokens.usage: Failure and danger: a halted step, a prompt-injection flag, a wrong quiz answer, mistake numbers, over-budget metrics. Always paired with a word.

tokens.name: bad-soft
tokens.usage: Fill behind bad text; a wrong quiz option.

tokens.name: chain
tokens.usage: LangChain (build). Same hue as accent, so LangChain sections read as the guide's home colour.

tokens.name: chain-soft
tokens.usage: Fill behind chain text.

tokens.name: graph
tokens.usage: LangGraph (orchestrate). Node fills, graph-tab pills, the graph column of comparison tables.

tokens.name: graph-soft
tokens.usage: Fill behind graph text.

tokens.name: fuse
tokens.usage: Langfuse (observe). Shares the observe hue on purpose: tracing is how you watch the loop's results.

tokens.name: fuse-soft
tokens.usage: Fill behind fuse text.

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: Status: healthy, passed, within budget. Used by the tool and metrics modules where 'final' would mislead.

tokens.name: ok-soft
tokens.usage: Fill behind ok text.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Status: needs attention, retrying, near budget.

tokens.name: warn-soft
tokens.usage: Fill behind warn text.

tokens.name: p0
tokens.usage: Priority P0, launch blocker. Badge text and the 4px top rule on the P0 card.

tokens.name: p0-soft
tokens.usage: Fill behind the P0 badge.

tokens.name: p1
tokens.usage: Priority P1, core health, reviewed weekly.

tokens.name: p1-soft
tokens.usage: Fill behind the P1 badge.

tokens.name: p2
tokens.usage: Priority P2, optimisation, reviewed monthly or quarterly.

tokens.name: p2-soft
tokens.usage: Fill behind the P2 badge.

tokens.name: b1
tokens.usage: LangGraph time travel: a forked branch, an edited checkpoint, the rewind bar. Text on bg, surface and b1-soft.

tokens.name: b1-soft
tokens.usage: Fill behind b1 text; the rewind bar and a selected checkpoint row. In light, b1 on b1-soft is 4.46:1, a hair under 4.5:1; kept exact from the source.

families.mono: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, "Cascadia Mono", Consolas, monospace

styles.name: cover-title
styles.usage: Home page h1 only; clamp(2.2rem, 5.8vw, 3.6rem), max 20ch.
styles.sample: Agents, explained for the people who ship them

styles.name: section-title
styles.sample: Decide whether you need an agent at all

styles.name: module-number
styles.usage: The big accent numeral on a home-page module card.

styles.name: card-title
styles.usage: h3: box, panel and cheat-sheet headings.
styles.sample: The five parts of every agent

styles.name: formula
styles.usage: Cheat-sheet formulas; the key term is set in accent.

styles.name: takeaway
styles.usage: The one-sentence takeaway after a 2px ink rule.
styles.sample: Choose the lowest level of autonomy that handles your real cases.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: h4, table headers, step titles, quiz questions.

styles.name: lede
styles.usage: Hero lede under the h1, in muted with strong phrases in ink; max 62ch.
styles.sample: Interactive guides for product managers, built around one running example.

styles.name: intro
styles.usage: Stage intro under a section title, in muted; max 64ch.
styles.sample: Before anyone writes code, be clear about what an agent is.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: An agent is an LLM that works in a loop. It decides on an action, uses a tool, looks at the result, and decides again.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Text inside boxes, tables and lists.
styles.sample: Start with the simplest thing that works.

styles.name: caption
styles.sample: Each step lights up the node the agent is in.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase kicker above a title ('Stage 2 · Design').

styles.name: tag
styles.usage: Uppercase pills: tags, loop-phase kinds, priority badges.

styles.name: status
styles.usage: Status bars and run meta: steps, tokens, cost. Tabular figures.

styles.name: log
styles.usage: The engineer's event log and trace detail.

styles.name: metric
styles.usage: Numbers in metric tiles and calculators. Tabular figures.

spacing.note: The guides use px gaps directly; these are the steps that recur.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Inside chip rows and the stage rail; list item gap.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between chips and tags.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Button rows, stage-head stack, quiz options.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Top-bar items, quiz stack, timeline steps; inner padding of steps (12×14).

tokens.name: space-14
tokens.usage: Grid gap for boxes (g2, g3) and card rows; hero stack.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Side gutter minimum; demo and callout padding.

tokens.name: space-18
tokens.usage: Box, quiz and mistake-card padding; module card gap.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Home-page module card padding.

tokens.name: space-28
tokens.usage: Gap between blocks inside a stage section.

tokens.name: space-40
tokens.usage: Before the next-module bar and the footer.

tokens.name: space-56
tokens.usage: Top padding of each stage section and the home hero.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Keyboard keys, status stamps.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inline code chips, tool-call snippets, quiz check squares, focus ring corners.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, selects, quiz options, metric tiles.

tokens.name: radius
tokens.usage: The module default: boxes, callouts, tables, figures, code blocks, popovers.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Home-page module cards.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Large consoles: the live demo, quizzes, the cheat sheet, the search dialog.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Chips, tags, phase pills, the theme and home buttons, active rail stage.

tokens.name: shadow-pop
tokens.usage: Glossary popover and tool hover card. The only floating shadow; cards use borders.

tokens.name: shadow-dialog
tokens.usage: The search dialog over its scrim.

tokens.name: page-max
tokens.usage: Module page width (.wrap).

tokens.name: home-max
tokens.usage: Home and reference page width.

tokens.name: measure
tokens.usage: Running text width (.prose); ledes use 62ch.

tokens.name: topbar-height
tokens.usage: Minimum height of the sticky top bar; scroll-padding-top is 72px.
